name: @playform/plugin-dsh-cost-analysis
description: The read-only analysis half of the cost family: a DeepHarness plugin that opens the SQLite ledger the @playform/plugin-dsh-cost plugin wrote with { readOnly: true } and answers questions about contribution and efficiency - the read credit a file earned by warming the prompt cache, the read-before-edit effectiveness of its edits, the cost per surviving line, the exploration overhead no file paid for, and the per-file cache efficiency. It never writes a row, never creates a table, and never registers a tool or a prompt section: its only surface is one slash command rendered outside model history. Plan: Documentation/Plans/COST-TRACK-PLUGIN.md sections 11-13 and 16.
